name: Tizanidine
summary: Tizanidine. Classification: Other central nervous system medication.
generalRisks: This entry does not contain a complete risk or interaction assessment. Missing information or an absent interaction warning does not mean that a substance or combination is safe.
metabolism: Extensively metabolized, chiefly by CYP1A2. Metabolites are not known to be active; elimination of drug-related material occurs mainly in urine and partly feces.
